title: erysimum lanceolatum subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Erysimum lanceolatum subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as Mountain Whitetop, is a perennial plant species within the Brassicaceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and lance-shaped leaves. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Whitetop include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
